model.description: Bayesian multinomial logit of not voting and each list on the ballot, all eight elections jointly; effects of age, gender, education, residence, religious attendance and socio-economic position drift across elections for the five long-running lineages, with six constant interactions.

notes.ses: Relative socio-economic position within each election, from occupation (ISEI) and household income, measured with error; its effect is net of education.
notes.residence: Five categories; from 2023 rebuilt from the municipality code and population (matches the survey's own coding in 2015 and 2019 for 99-100%).
notes.calibration: Calibrated estimates shift each list's log-odds against not voting until the sample reproduces the official turnout and list shares.
notes.refusers: Voters who give no party (4-9% of voters) are left out of the headline estimates; imputing them and shifting them up to 1.5 points left on left-right changes no effect's sign.
notes.other: 'Other lists' means different lists at different elections and is never drawn as a series.

levels: Never or about once a year
